'''Scrye''' (stylized ''SCRYE'') was a United States collectible-card-game magazine published from 1994 to April 2009. Scrye, Inc. sold it to Krause Publications on 15 November 1999.<ref name="wp-scrye" /> With ''[[InQuest]]'', it was one of the two large CCG magazines of the mid-1990s.<ref name="wp-iq" />

Decipher packed SWCCG checklists, rules supplements, a Players Guide through [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]], and an oversized [[Boba Fett]] sticker in ''Scrye'' issues from 1997 into 1998.<ref name="enc183" /> Wikipedia lists later SWCCG strategy in issues 52 and 58 and a preview in issue 68.<ref name="wp-swccg" /> Display ads also ran in the magazine.<ref name="enc165" />

The dated catalog is [[Magazines]].
